original_question: Cecilia just bought a new puppy. According to her veterinarian, she has to feed the puppy 1 cup of dog food every day for the first 180 days. Then she has to feed the puppy 2 cups of dog food every day for the rest of its life. If a bag of dog food contains 110 cups, how many bags of dog food will Cecilia use in the first year?
question_template: {name_female, Cecilia} just bought a new puppy. question_solution: answer = ((num_digit_1 * num_digit_2 + num_digit_3 * (365 - num_digit_2)) + num_digit_4 - 1) // num_digit_4
